tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /jo gdan bla ma mang thos bshes gnyen pas dris lan yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang / /chos dang dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dbyer med bla ma la btud nas/ /dris lan yid kyi mun sel bshad/ /bla ma jo gdan pas yi ge rten bcas 'phrod pas sems spro zhing gnas tshul nges par byung / khyed kyi dri ba dang po sdom gsum gyi rab tu dbye bar/ bod gangs can gyi khrod du bstan pa la 'phel 'grib byung tshul bshad pa'i skabs su/ lo chen rin bzang gi slob ma zhi ba 'od kyis sngags log sun 'byin gyi bstan bcos mdzad zer ba dang / 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis kyang chos log sun 'byin gyi bstan bcos mdzad par gsungs 'dug pa'i/ gsung rab de dag gi gzhung tshad dang / brjod don ji lta bu zhig mchis lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ skyes bu dam pa de gnyis kyis bstan pa la gcig tu dgongs pa'i thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos de dag gzhung tshad ha cang che ba mi snang bas 'dir bri bar bya yis/ brjod don rnams bklags shing bsam pas rtogs pa yin no/ /de la yang gnyis te/ lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa dang / 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ pho brang zhi ba 'od kyis bod kyi sngags pa rnams la gnang ba'i bka' dam gsung shog las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ pu hrang gi pho brang zhi ba 'od/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi rgyud dang / 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs dang / dkyil 'khor cho ga mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad de/ bod kyi rgyal khams kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnas shing rdo rje theg pa la zhugs pa rnams la brtse bar dgongs nas chu spre'u'i lo la bka' shog brdzangs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' ltar bcos pa'i rgyud dang 'grel pa dang /

sgrub thabs snga phyir bod du byung pa la/ rgya gar mar ming btags shing bod kyis byas pa ni 'di dag ste/ sngar gyi dus kyi phyi rgyud kyi ngan song sbyong ba'i 'grel pa che chung ngam/ rgyan dam pa la sogs pa'i cho ga che phra mang du yod pa rnams dang / khams nas byung pa rnams la ma nor cher med/ de yang 'di dang mthun par dpyad na/ kṛ ya'i cho ga rnams dang / 'grel pa ltar bcos pa'i snyel rnams dang / nang pa la sgyu 'phrul gyi rgyud la bcu gsum dang / bcu dgu pa dang / bzhi bcu pa dang / brgyad cu pa dang / le'u la sogs pa rnams ni 'dres mar snang / zur shag 'byung la sogs pas byas pa'i gsang ba snying po'i 'grel pa yar khab dang / sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa'i 'grel pa dang / mig bcu drug pa la sogs pa'i 'grel pa rnams dang / rdo rje las rim la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs rnams dang / cho ga che phran rnams dang / dar rje dpal gyi grags pas byas zer ba'i mdo lnga la/ zur che chung gis byas pa'i 'grel pa rnams dang / 'khor lo ting rdzogs dang / thig le sgron ma dang / rnal 'byor lam rim dang / rnal 'byor mig gi sgron ma la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs rtsa 'grel dang / mya ngan las 'das pa che chung la sogs pa dang / phur pa'i rgyud la khu byug rol pa dang / de'i bshad rgyud kī la ya tan+t+ra dang / dgongs pa lung ston dang / gsang ba gter sbas dang / rdo rje gsal ba bkod pa dang / kī la ya tan+t+ra chung ngu dang / bya to'i rgyud du gsol ba dang / stag mo kha gdang dang / seng ge kha gdang dang / phag mo kha gdang dang / gsang phur kha gdang dang / tshul nag rol pa dang / zhe sdang sems su dag pa'i rgyud dang / gsang sngags drug gi rgyud dang / 'grel pa dang cho gar bcas pa dang / 'phros pa'i man ngag gi rgyud lnga zer te/ chags rgyud dang / gshin rje gshed snyel rnams dang / gzhan yang snub sangs rgyas rin po ches byas pa'i dpal khro bo'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud kyi rgyal po drug dang /

bdud rtsi bam po brgyad pa la sogs pa sgrub thabs kyi rgyud dang / sgrub thabs dang bcas pa rnams dang / yang snub sangs rgyas rin po ches byas pa'i rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' che'i 'grel pa rigs pa'i nyi ma la sogs pa'i man ngag tu gsol ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyud rog ti dang / lcags phye 'bar ba dang / nag po'i rgyud dgu dang / u tsa tra ma dang / 'dra med bong lto la sogs pa cho ga dpag tu med pa dang / ā tsar+ya ma la ma tris bsgyur ba'i sems phyogs kyi 'gyur bcu gsum la/ rmad byung ba'i le'u bzhi bcu zhe gsum dang / byang chub kyi sems bde 'byams rin po che dang / lta ba bal nag la sogs pa'i 'grel pa dang / sa gcod dang yig chung du bcas pa dang / nyang stod khro khang du drag shag tshul gyis brtsams pa'i sems te bco brgyad kyi rgyud rnams la/ kun byed rgyal po dang / mdo bcu gsang ba dang / ye shes gsang ba la sogs la dang / 'grel pa dang / sa gcod dang / dbang bskur gyi yi ge dang / bsgom pa'i man ngag dang / sems nyams kyi man ngag dang / srid pa'i rgyud lung la sogs pa dang / ma mo'i rgyud lung la sogs pa ma mo'i chos thams cad dang / gzhan yang rgyal po'i chos lnga la sogs te rgyud dang 'grel pa dang man ngag dang chos ming btags pa dpag tu med do/ /phyis gsar du byung ba'i rgyud dang 'grel pa dang / man ngag dang / sgrub thabs dang / ā tsar+ya dmar pos byas pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i thig le dang / gsang chen thig le dang / ye shes snying po'i rgyud dang / de dag gi 'grel pa dang / char yang rnam gsum dang / rin chen snye ma dang / rin chen thig pa dang / rin chen phreng ba dang / dbang gi man ngag la sogs pa dang / sgrub thabs mang po dang / dbang rin po che 'khor lo la sogs pa'i man ngag rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad zer ba dang / sgron gsal gyi ṭik+ka bha wa ma dang / rim lnga'i 'grel pa slob dpon klu'i byang chub kyis mdzad zer ba dang /

kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsar ma le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'i 'grel pa dang / man ngag dang / de'i sgrub thabs dang bcas pa dang / u rgyan gyi yul nas sems phyogs kyi chos byung zer te byas pa/ srog 'byung nam mkha'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / de'i bshad rgyud dang / glang dpal gyi ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'i phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi rgyud dang / 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang / sbyin sreg gi cho ga dang / sgrub thabs bha wa ma che chung la sogs pa dpag du med pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta mi tri ba'i chos la rin po che'i phreng ba dang / na ga dzu nas mdzad zer ba'i phyag rgya bzhi pa dang / phyag rgya lnga pa dang / dbang rnam par nges pa rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa dang / phyag rgya bzhi pa'i man ngag dang / sems 'dzin rnams dang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang / rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs dang / sgrub thabs dang / theg pa chen po nyi shu pa dang / bcu pa dang / sgyu ma nges pa dang / rmi lam nges pa la sogs pa rnams ni spyod pa gzhan dang mthun pa ltar snang na yang / lta ba dang man ngag rdzogs rim mu stegs pa dang bsres nas snang bas byar mi rung ngo / /gzhan yang man ngag gser phreng la sogs pa rdo ha ka ṣa glu la bslad pa dang / bal po shrī singha'i glu la bslad pa la sogs pa thad ka ma gcig kyang med do/ /'di rnams gang yang yang dag pa'i lam ma yin zhing / bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par mi 'gyur bas skyabs gnas dang / lam du sus kyang byar mi rung / rab tu byung ba rnams kyis 'dul ba bzhin srung zhing bka' gsang sngags la zhugs pa dang / mos pa rnams kyis kyang 'dul ba la brten la de dang mi 'gal ba kṛ ya dang / spyod rgyud dang / yo ga dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i bar la dam tshig ma nyams par byas la 'bad do/ /shes rab kyi rgyud ni mchog tu gyur pa yin yang dgongs pa can gyi tshig don ma shes nas rab tu byung ba bslab pa dang /

ma byas kyang 'gal ba med pa tsam khyad par du yang rdzogs pa chen po ni lta ba mu stegs kyi rim pa dang bsres pas 'di byas na ngan song gi lam du 'gro bar 'gyur zhing / bla na med pa'i byang chub la gegs byed pas rnam pa thams cad du byar mi rung / bod kyis byas pa'i sngags dang yi ge la mi g.yo ba'i sngags la brten nas phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs yin zer ba dang / gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i sngags la brten nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs dang man ngag zer ba dang / gnyan ā tsar+ya dpal dbyangs kyis byas pa'i sgron ma rnam drug dang / gtor ma dang / 'phrin las dang / man ngag tu byas pa dang / gzhan yang bod kyis byas pa'i sgrub thabs mang du yod pas/ blo gtad du mi btub 'khor ba ngan song gi lam yin no/ /bka' gdams kyi chos brgyud du grags pa rnams kyi chos log 'di rnams nyams su mi blangs so/ /pho brang zhi ba 'od kyis chos pa rnams la 'phrin du brdzangs pa'o/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad pa ni/ lo tsā ba de nyid kyis bod kyi chos pa rnams la gnang ba'i springs yig las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis bod kyi chos pa rnams la springs pa/ bskal pa bzang po 'di la dus bzhi las bde bar gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus su sems can thams cad ma bslab par dge ba bcu rang gi ngang gis rdzogs pa dang ldan pas rdzogs ldan zhes bya'o/ /de nas bar gyi bskal pa gnyis pa la bde bar gshegs pa gser thub byon pa'i dus su dge ba bcu la srog gcod tshig rtsub gnod sems gsum spong bas gsum ldan zhes bya'o/ /de nas bar bskal gsum pa nas 'od srung byon pa'i dus su sems can rnams kyis srog gcod dang tshig rtsub gnyis spong bas gnyis ldan zhes bya'o/

/de yan chad du pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos gsungs/ 'bras bu byang chub gsum ka la bkod pa yin/ de nas sangs rgyas shākya thub pa byon pa'i dus su snyigs ma lnga bdo mi dge ba bcu spyod pas rtsod ldan zhes bya'o/ /de'i dus su gsang sngags sgron me lta bu'i chos byung ste/ bya ba'i rgyud dang / spyod pa'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang gsum gsungs/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan nas/ u rgyan gyi ri la thabs rgyud dang shes rab kyi rgyud gsungs so zhes kha cig zer ro/ /la la na re/ sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo brgya dang bcu gnyis nas rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs zer te/ paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad la dris pas mi bden gsungs/ de nas rim gyis bod kyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku ring la lo tsā ba rnams kyis sde snod gsum gyi chos gsungs/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde gsum bsgyur zhing gtan la phab pa yin no/ /de nas mi rabs gcig nas lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs dang / cog bkra shis dpal gyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / zla gsang thig le/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba rnams bsgyur ro/ /de rnams ni bka' dri ma med pa yin no/ /de nas dus phyis rma rin chen mchog gis gsang ba snying po brtsams so/ /de'i kha skong du sgyu 'phrul le lag brtsams la/ rgyal blon gyis rig nas bka' chad dbab par byas nas lo bcu ma rnyed skad/ dus phyis gtsang gi nyang ror shi'o/ /de la brten nas zur che chung gis gsang ba snying po'i 'grel pa dang / dkyil chog dang / sgrub thabs mang po rang bzor sbyar ro/ /sgyu 'phrul gyi chos de dag thams cad chos log dri ma can bod kyi rang bzo yin no/ /rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la bai ro tsa nas rgya gar las khungs btsal nas sems phyogs la sogs pa nam mkha' che dang / sku la 'jug pa dang /

rtsal chen dang / rdzogs pa spyi gcod dang / rig pa'i khu byug dang lnga brtsams pa rgyal blon gyis rig nas tsha ba rong du spyugs so/ /snub sangs rgyas rin po ches rgya gar las rdzun gyi khungs sbyar nas rmad du byung pa la sogs pa'i chos bcu gsum byas so/ /sngar gyi lnga bsnan pas bco brgyad/ sems lung chen mo dang kun bod kyis byas pa'i dri ma can yin no/ /a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyis byas pa'i sems phyogs lnga'i 'grel pa dang / sems nyams che chung dang / dar chen rje dpal gyi grags pas byas pa'i chos la dgongs 'dus dang / kun 'dus dang / rgyal po'i chos lnga ste dri ma can yin no/ /yang snub sangs rgyas rin po ches kī la ya bcu gnyis kyi tan+t+ra brtsams so/ /de la brten nas bod rnams kyis chos dri ma can bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas so/ /de dag thams cad rgya gar na med cing chos log dri ma can yin no/ /gzhan yang snub sangs rgyas rin po ches phra khod snang rgyud bya ba gshin rje'i rgyud brtsams so/ /yang zhi khro la ra hu la'i gza' rgyud che chung dang / gdong mo chu 'khyags la sogs mang po brtsams so/ /yang ma mo 'dus pa'i rgyud bya ba brtsams/ de la brten nas bod kyis ma mo'i chos mang po brtsams gda'o/ /yang pad+ma dbang chen brtsams te mu stegs kyi chos dang 'dres pas dri ma can yin no/ /sku'i rgyud rdo rje thogs med/ gsung gi rta mchog rol pa/ thugs kyi rgyud sun+dha ri ka'i rgyud dang / yon tan gyi rgyud rin po che ma gol ba'i rgyud dang / 'phrin las kyi skarma ma lo'i rgyud dang / kā la ya bcu gnyis kyi rgyud dang / bdud rtsi bam po brgyad pa dang / ma mo 'dus pa'i rgyud dang / gshin rje phra khod snang gi rgyud de de rnams la bsgrub lugs kyi rgyud dgu zer ro/ /kha skong gi rgyud drug la chos nyid zhi ba'i rgyud dang / dpal 'bar khro mo'i rgyud dang /

tshogs rgyud chen po'i rgyud dang / gnas lung chen mo'i rgyud dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyud dang drug go /rgyud kyi rgyal po drug la/ dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud dang / kun tu bzang po che ba rang la gnas pa'i rgyud dang / ting nge 'dzin pa mchog gi rgyud dang / rtsom pa don ldan gyi rgyud dang / yon tan rin po che'i rgyud dang / skarma ma lo'i rgyud dang drug go /gzhan yang lung sgrub thabs kyi yi ge bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang / 'da' ka ma'i chos bzhi dang / sgrub thabs dang / man ngag dang / gtor ma dang / 'phrin las du ma yod de de thams cad snub kyis byas pa'i dri ma can yin no/ /gnyan chen dpal dbyangs kyis sgron ma rnam drug dang / lta ba'i yig chung gnyis byas so/ /dri ma med pa'i chos la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang / de la rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi tas byas pa'i 'grel pa dang sgrub thabs thams cad ni dri ma med pa yin no/ /nang gi la gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dgongs pa lung ston dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus dang / lha mo bzhis zhus dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / shes rab kyi rgyud la dges pa rdo rje dang / 'khor lo sdom pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi dang / sgyu 'phrul chen mo dang / de rnams kyi rgyud phyi ma dang / bshad pa'i rgyud sam+bu ṭi dang / rdo rje gur dang / dgongs pa lung ston dang / de rnams la rgya gar bas byas pa'i 'grel pa dang / sgrub thabs mang po yod de ma nor ba dri ma med pa'i chos yin no/ /phyi'i la de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud dang / rdo rja rtse mo dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang / de dag gi 'grel pa sgrub thabs dang bcas pa thams cad ma nor ba dri ma med pa'i chos yin no/ /lo tsā ba chen po 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyis chos log dri ma can dang /

chos dri ma med pa'i khyad par dbye ba'i phyir dang / yang dag pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i phyir dang / mkhas pa rnams shes rab kyi chos la dpyad par bya ba'i phyir/ sngags pa dang rab tu byung ba'i chos nor ba la spyod pa la 'di bskur ro/ /lan gsum du rgya gar la phyin nas gtan la phab pa yin no/ /zhes pa de rnams kyis 'gos khug pa lhas btsas kyi gsung rab las 'byung tshul bshad zin te/ dri ba dang po'i lan bstan zin to/ /yang dri ba gnyis pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sa skya pa'i gdung rabs chen mo'i nang na/ sa paṇa gyi slob ma 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge bsnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dngos slob yin tshul gsungs 'dug pa/ de'i lo rgyus snyan brgyud du bzhugs pa lags sam/ yi ge rnying pa 'ga' zhig tu 'byung ba lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ 'di'i lo rgyus bla ma rnams kyi gsung las kyang thos mod/ lhag par chos rje sa paṇa la 'u yug pas dri ba mdzad pa'i lan gsungs tshul rnams bla ma bsod nams dpal gyis zin bris su mdzad pa'i dpe rnying las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chen po chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gdan sa chen por 'chad nyan mdzad cing bzhugs yod pa'i dus shig gi tshe/ gsang ne'u thog nas bsnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma 'u yug pa chen po rtsod pa'i phyir byon nas/ bsnyen bkur sngon du 'gro pa'i shis pa'i tshig gis dges par mdzad nas/ 'di ltar dri ba byas so zhes bla ma'i zhal snga nas thos pa ni 'di ltar ste/ 'u yug pa chen pos gsol pa/ chos rje ba/ grub mtha' gong 'og gi khyad par mdor bsdus pa ci lta bu lags/ chos rje pas bka' stsal pa/ grub mtha' gong 'og gi khyad par mdor bsdus pa ni 'di ltar te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ phyin ci log bzhi'i lta ba phung khrol ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/

grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa'i byis pa rnams ni/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa la rtag par lta ba dang / 'khor ba mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar lta ba dang / zag bcas sdug bsngal ba la bde bar lta ba dang / chos bdag med pa la bdag tu lta ba'i phyin ci log gi chu bo bzhis g.yengs nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor ba lags mod/ grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams ni/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel par/ ma rig pa'i ling thog gis khebs pa'i mu stegs rnams kyang lam 'tshol par byed pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyu 'tshol ba dang / lam 'tshol ba dang / 'bras bu 'tshol ba dang / de dag gi 'thad pa 'tshol ba ste/ spyir 'tshol ba bzhi'i grub mtha' la gnas pa yin/ de las kyang nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams ni/ 'dul ba lung las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos gcig gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag zag bcas thams cad ni sdug bsngal/ chos thams cad ni bdag med/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par lta ba dang / zag pa dang bcas pa thams cad sdug bsngal bar lta ba dang / chos thams cad bdag med par lta ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa zhi bar lta ba ste/ lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi khas len pa la spyir gnas pa yin/ de nas kyang gong du/ theg chen gyi grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams ni/ lang dkar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ rang bzhin gsum dang chos lnga dang / /rnam par shes pa brgyad nyid dang / /bdag med gnyis kyi dngos por ni/ /theg chen mtha' dag 'dus pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad kun brtags/ gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum du 'du ba dang / chos dang / ming dang / rgyu mtshan dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i ye shes lnga ru 'du ba dang / chos can mthar thug rnam shes tshogs brgyad du 'du ba dang / chos nyid mthar thug gang zag dang / chos kyi bdag med gnyis su 'du ba ste/

theg chen mtha' dag bsdus pa'i chos bzhi khas len pa la spyir gnas pa yin/ de las kyang gong du dbu ma'i grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pa/ /de bzhin stong nyid ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos thams cad rang bzhin stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa/ rgyud bla ma las/ rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes pa ltar/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs can dang dam chos pad+ma dkar po las/ theg pa gcig ste gnyis pa yod ma yin/ /gsum pa nam yang yod min 'jig rten na/ /skyes bu mchog rnams thabs kyi theg pa gang / /sna tshogs nye bar ston pa mdzad ma gtogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam mthar thug theg pa gcig tu nges pa dang / phar phyin las/ skye bo thams cad bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug pa 'gro ba can yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can thams cad sangs rgya rung ba ste/ dam bca' chen po bzhi khas len pa la spyir gnas pa yin/ de las kyang gong du gsang sngags kyi grub mtha' la zhugs pa rnams ni/ kṛ ya rgyas pa las/ don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo rgyud gnyis gzhi mthar thug bden gnyis zung 'jug lam mthar thug thabs shes zung 'jug 'bras bu mthar thug sku gnyis zung 'jug tu don gcig kyang / de rtogs pa'i thabs la rmongs ma rmongs kyi khyad par dang / thabs mang nyung gi khyad par dang / mngon shes myur mi myur gyi dbang gis dbang po rno rtul gyi khyad par te khyad par 'phags chos bzhi khas len pa la spyir gnas pa lags mod/

'di dag gi don rgyas par mkhyen par bzhed na/ kho bos byas pa'i grub mtha' shan 'byed ces pa'i gzhung lugs de la gzigs mdzod dang des thugs tshim par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs ma thag tu 'u yug pa chen po thugs tshim nas rtsod pa'i go cha dor te/ gus pas phyag mdzad nas/ de nyid kyi drung du yun ring du gnas nas don 'di dag la mkhas par bya'o snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di skad ces gsungs te/ shes bya kun la mkhyen rab gsal/ /lnga rig dbang po bdag dga'i dpal/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'gro ba'i mgon/ /khyod zhabs rtag tu bsten par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs par grags so zhes rje bla ma gsungs/ skye ba skye ba med pa'i tshul rtogs kyang / /da dung skye ba'i gzeb nas bdag ma grol/ /skyes nas skye bar las kyis skye 'gyur ba'i/ /skye ngan bdag ni skye las grol gyur cig /mkhyen rab dbang phyug chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la/ 'u yug pa chen po 'jal ba'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus pa 'di ni/ rje bla ma'i gsung bgros la brten nas mdo rgyud 'dzin pa'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal ldan gyis rang gi dran pa gso ba'i phyir du bris pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /'di lta bu ni bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa ste/ mkhas pas mkhas par re ba'i slob ma'i mchog /gzhan la gzhan phan 'joms phyir mngags pa'i tshe/ /rang blos rang gi slob dpon rigs spangs nas/ /chos rje chos kyi rgyal po rtag tu bsten/ /'di 'dra sngon gyi ngo mtshar gtam/ /yin gyi deng sang 'di na yang / /ngan pa'i slob dpon blo ldan gyi/ /slob mas phyi nas spangs zhes thos/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de rnams kyis dri ba gnyis pa'i lan bstan zin to/ /dri ba gsum pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i ming thob pa la/ kā lā pa dang / tsan+t+ra pa sogs sgra rig la mkhas pa zhig dgos kyi/ gzhan la paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i ming btags mi rung zer ba'i rigs 'ga' zhig 'dug pa ji ltar lags/

zhes pa'i lan ni/ de lta bu ni mkhas par rlom pa su zhig zer yang ma brtags pa chen po ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rgya skad du paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa/ bod skad du mkhas pa ste/ de lta bu'i ming mang po la btags su rung ba/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bstan bcos mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo sogs su gsal bar gsungs te/ ji skad du/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa/ /de'ang de la mkhas pa yin/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ mkhas pa zhes bya ba gang zhe na/ shes bya thams cad phyin ci ma log par shes pa yin la/ gzhan yang bye brag gang bslabs pa shes pa de la'ang de nyid la mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i ming thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bzo rig gi mahā paṇ+ḍi ta'am/ bzo rig gi mkhas pa chen po/ gso ba rig pa'i mahā paṇ+ḍi ta'am/ gso rig gi mkhas pa chen po/ de bzhin du sgra rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ nang don rig pa sogs rig gnas che chung / yon tan gyi cha gang la byang chub par shes kyang / de dang de'i mkhas pa'am/ de dang de'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhes ming btags su rung ba yin gyis/ sgra rig ma shes pa tsam la paṇ+ḍi ta'i ming mi thob pa ga la srid/ des na skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba zhes pa'i ming thogs pa la/ sgra'i rig gnas la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa zhig dgos par go lags/ zab yangs blo gros dang ldan yang / /gsung rab don la 'ol spyod kyis/ /smra na rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i/ /mkhas pa gzhan dag khrel min nam/ /zhes pa'ang skabs su babs pa'i tshig bcad do/ /de rnams kyis dri ba gsum pa'i lan bstan zin te/ dris lan ma lus pa tshang bar bshad zin to/ /de ltar mang thos dpyod ldan gzur gnas kyis/ /tshul bzhin dris pa'i dris lan nyung ngu 'di/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes byas sbyar/ /ding sang yid srub kyis bslad mkhas rloms 'gas/

/gzhan gyi dpal 'phrog tshig ngan rlung dmar gyis/ /skyon bral zla ba dri med chu gtsang la/ /snang ba'i skabs bral tshul de bsam bzhin skyo/ /de phyir log spyod ngan pa'i rjes 'brangs rnams/ /ba tshwa'i chu 'dres yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /logs su phyung ba mkhas pa'i rnam thar te/ /de phyir 'di la'ang blo ldan su zhig 'khu/ /e ma bdag ni 'di phyi'i don thams cad/ /yid bzhin 'grub pa bslu med bla ma las/ /gzhan du re ba med pa'i mos gus 'dis/ /bsam pa thams cad 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces bla ma jo gdan pa mang thos bshes gnyen pas tshul bzhin dris pa'i lan yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba 'di yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po'i gsung las skyes pa'i sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa tshe dbang dpal bzang gis bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 a myes zhabs/ jo gdan bla ma mang thos bshes gnyen pa'i dris lan yid kyi mun sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 11
